item.title: Mince Pie Challenge: Setting up Flow with Babel and Webpack
item.description: We have now settled on how our application will perform user authentication. I now wish to take a step back and help improve our code confidence by adding the static type checker Flow. In this article, I will document the process of configuring Flow with Babel and Webpack, expanding upon our previous example by adding sufficient typing.

item.title: Mince Pie Challenge: Setting up the Serverless Framework with Docker, Webpack and Babel
item.description: Now that we have spent some time working out how the API is going to look, we can move on to building it! We will start off by configuring the initial API project, setting up a Dockerised Serverless Framework with Webpack and Babel support.
